title: Shell Pattern Corrections Schema
description: Schema for .claude/metadata/shell-pattern-corrections.json — Git Bash command-shape corrections that .claude/hooks/shell-safety-hook.js emits only when the Bash command about to run matches a detector (#2997). Moved out of the always-on 05-windows-shell rule. The hook fails open: absent or malformed data means no correction and no block.

_meta.description: Human-facing provenance. Never read by the hook.

detector.description: Regular expression tested against tool_input.command. A source that does not compile disables only its own entry.

disposition.description: `advise`: append the text to PreToolUse additionalContext; the call proceeds. `block`: exit 2 with the text on stderr. Reserved for shapes that are always wrong on Git Bash.
